target_truth_policy: target truth and paired C+N are evaluation/label only; never inference feature

metric_definitions.screen_background_pfa: local region cells against the current-map GO-CFAR threshold; used for cheap Pareto screening
metric_definitions.screen_target_cfar_margin: local target ROI against the current-map GO-CFAR threshold
metric_definitions.exact_background_Pfa: full-map GO-CFAR recomputed on each representative candidate
metric_definitions.exact_target_cfar_margin: full-map candidate target ROI against its freshly recomputed GO-CFAR threshold
metric_definitions.exact_representatives: Current plus max-SCNR, min-tail, min-background-Pfa and max-margin representatives per case

go_no_go.rule: GO only if worthwhile regions, median gain, grouped predictor evidence, and all cases pass; thresholds were fixed in this audit run
